en.title: Ramadan Gatherings Across Cambridge Hospital
en.excerpt: Cambridge Hospital marked Ramadan through internal Iftar and Suhoor gatherings across Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Dhahran and Jeddah. External stakeholder Iftars also...
en.body: Cambridge Hospital marked Ramadan through internal Iftar and Suhoor gatherings across Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Dhahran and Jeddah. External stakeholder Iftars also brought together healthcare, government and community partners, strengthening relationships while reflecting the values of compassion, gratitude and togetherness.
